entities.name: Table T1 – DCI Survey Significant Obstacles and Key Drivers
entities.brief: Survey of data center project obstacles and drivers
entities.description: Aggregates significance and response rates for general obstacles and specific drivers from Schneider Electric survey

properties.table_content:
| Obstacle / Specific Issue                                       | Extremely Significant (%) | Very Significant (%) | Somewhat Significant (%) | Total Significant (%) | Response Rate (%) |
|-----------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------|----------------------|--------------------------|-----------------------|-------------------|
| Utility capacity or transmission constraints                    | 40                        | 33                   | 19                       | 92                    |                   |
| Permitting issues                                               | 26                        | 30                   | 30                       | 86                    |                   |
| Fiber availability                                              | 26                        | 33                   | 26                       | 85                    |                   |
| Access to computer chips                                        | 32                        | 34                   | 15                       | 81                    |                   |
| Natural gas availability                                        | 19                        | 23                   | 34                       | 76                    |                   |
| Land availability                                               | 17                        | 30                   | 27                       | 74                    |                   |
| Public opposition                                               | 16                        | 25                   | 33                       | 74                    |                   |
| Water availability                                              | 21                        | 20                   | 32                       | 73                    |                   |
| Utility quoted long wait time for more power                    |                           |                      |                          |                       | 46                |
| Utility quoted high cost for more power                         |                           |                      |                          |                       | 43                |
| Long lead time for on-site power generation equipment           |                           |                      |                          |                       | 42                |
| Utility power has unpredictable energy rates                    |                           |                      |                          |                       | 42                |
| Utility power reliability is inadequate                         |                           |                      |                          |                       | 32                |
| Utility has given no written promise on delivery time           |                           |                      |                          |                       | 32                |
| Site layout issues (e.g., space, can't run distribution lines)  |                           |                      |                          |                       | 27                |
| Not running into any challenges                                 |                           |                      |                          |                       | 15                |
| Utility does not enable sufficient renewable energy procurement |                           |                      |                          |                       | 13                |
| Not applicable / Don't know                                     |                           |                      |                          |                       | 8                 |
properties.key_insight: Utility capacity or transmission constraints cited by 92% as significant

entities.name: Table T2 – DCI Obstacle Significance Breakdown
entities.brief: Significance percentages for key data center project obstacles
entities.description: Breaks down extreme, very, and somewhat significant responses for common obstacles in data center projects

properties.table_content:
| Obstacle | Extremely Significant | Very Significant | Somewhat Significant | Total Significant |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Utility capacity or transmission constraints | 40% | 33% | 19% | 92% |
| Permitting issues | 26% | 30% | 30% | 86% |
| Fiber availability | 26% | 33% | 26% | 85% |
| Access to computer chips | 32% | 34% | 15% | 81% |
| Natural gas availability | 19% | 23% | 34% | 76% |
| Land availability | 17% | 30% | 27% | 74% |
| Public opposition | 16% | 25% | 33% | 74% |
| Water availability | 21% | 20% | 32% | 73% |
properties.key_insight: Utility capacity or transmission constraints remains the most significant obstacle at 92%

entities.name: Table T3 – DCI Power-related Obstacle Percentages
entities.brief: Percentage of respondents citing power-related challenges
entities.description: Ranks power-related obstacles by percentage of respondents citing each as significant challenge

properties.table_content:
| Obstacle                                                      | Percentage |
|---------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| Utility quoted long wait time for more power                  | 46%        |
| Utility quoted high cost for more power                       | 43%        |
| Long lead time for on-site power generation equipment         | 42%        |
| Utility power has unpredictable energy rates                  | 42%        |
| Utility power reliability is inadequate                       | 32%        |
| Utility has given no written promise on delivery time         | 32%        |
| Site layout issues (e.g., space, can't run distribution lines)| 27%        |
| Not running into any challenges                               | 15%        |
| Utility does not enable sufficient renewable energy procurement| 13%        |
| Not applicable / Don't know                                   | 8%         |
properties.key_insight: Long wait times (46%) and high power costs (43%) are the top concerns
